## TASK-001 - Record current inputs and preservation inventory

Reinspect the selected TRD, actual root/Template, relevant helpers, active writer scopes and read-only updater state. Record exact input hashes, existing changes, protected paths and a reviewed source/root/Template manifest in one bounded implementation evidence directory.

### Risks

- Preserve unrelated bytes and stop on stale inputs or a scope conflict.

### Acceptance criteria

- The TRD revision/digest and live dependencies are identified; a changed requirement or conflicting owner stops dependent work for reassessment.
- The manifest names each authorized source/root/Template destination and every protected path, including pre-existing records and independent projects.
- Read-only updater status and any existing watcher behavior are recorded without new service installation.

### Planned verification

- Run git status --porcelain=v1 -uall, inspect current source hashes and compare with this plan baseline.
- Run .venv/bin/python tools/template_update.py check and inspect its exact JSON result.
- Hash selected protected files and deterministic directory inventories before implementation, excluding only declared new output and existing volatile runtime state.

### Risks

- Preserve unrelated bytes and stop on stale inputs or a scope conflict.

### Acceptance criteria

- Each supported field, local context, stable identity, module lock, relation qualifier and fact classification has a documented meaning; unsupported JSON-LD features fail explicitly.

- The core contract requires only Python 3.12 standard-library capabilities and rejects remote context resolution.

### Planned verification

- Inspect path classification for canonical, generated and durable transaction files; verify no memory or Task schema extension appears.
